reviews.title: Fun..Has potential to be better!
reviews.text:
This game is surprisingly fun, I do like it more than others like this. However, I do wish they had an option to change appearance and clothing in game, as well as not for you to date the same sex in storylines, also wish story lines made more sense as my daughter had asked to live with their other parent after their friends parents had a divorce. My person and spouse were still together, so how could she live with the other  parent? 

I also wish more family members could participate in outings not just one, and more interactions with people on their part so I’m not the only one putting in effort and get the overbearing message..

***UPDATE***
Please fix the storylines! It’s so annoying when a parent dies, and then they are calling you. Orrr you ask your male bestfriend out and they say they aren’t interested in girls and then ask if it’s ok to date your friend who is a girl and is now dating a girl.. make that make sense please and many other story lines that just don’t make sense. 4.00 GPA but I’m about to fail a class if I don’t quit my sports team (I’m not on a sports team), etc. Please, please, please, fix !

reviews.title: Love the game
reviews.text: I love the game. I have so much fun playing with it. It’s so interactive you have so many different choices. One thing I think would be really cool as if we could pick the last names not just the first names. I also think it would be cool if we could have a little bit more diversity with characters and how they look like maybe a character with green eyes or a character with red hair and brown eyes that also look Hispanic just you know being able to mix it up. Also, I think it’ll be cool if we could go on plane for trips, not as road trips. As well as being able to immigrate and having immigrants in the story. But overall, the game is super fun and a great. There could be some more bug fixes and part-time jobs would be nice in high school. Cheerleading would be nice in high school. Also, I don’t know if this is the thing for other people but if you’re cheating or you have a boyfriend and a husband you should be able to get caught or talk about having a open relationship or something like that. It would also be nice to know if our friends and family have jobs and what their job is

reviews.title: Some fixes to be made
reviews.text:
It’s a fun game and I’ve been playing a lot since downloading. However, there’s a few things that irk me. One thing is you can’t graduate with a 4.0 GPA because it automatically goes down to 3.6 every year. How am I supposed to graduate with a 4.0 if the game physically won’t let me? 

The other being I can’t figure out how to follow the doctor career. I finish premed school but there’s no option for medical school and without that higher education, it’s a no go.
